top_signals.title: Bessent moves to curb Treasury yields, putting new pressure on Warsh's Fed
top_signals.summary: Treasury's move to buy back more long-term debt cooled a bond selloff, but economists warn it could raise new inflation and independence questions for the Fed
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Moderna’s 177% Surge Burns Shorts in ‘Painful’ $5.5 Billion Loss
top_signals.summary: A record surge in Moderna Inc.’s shares delivered a $5.5 billion blow to short sellers who had bet that the vaccine maker’s years-long slump would continue.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Investment Committee: Spotlight On SPACs
top_signals.summary: Desiree Carlo, senior vice president, client services at Laurel Hill, Christian Nagler, partner, capital markets at Kirkland & Ellis, and Betsy Cohen, chairman and co-founder at Cohen Circle, join Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discuss the uptick in the number of SPAC deals. (Source: Bloomberg)
